full_page.content:
ST. MICHAEL'S CHURCH 225 JEROME STREET BROOKLYN 7, N.Y. Dec. 23, 1945
Miss Doris Panyard Muskegon, Michigan
Dear Miss Panyard:
God bless you and yours. Many thanks for your charitable favor of Dec. 12th. Only To-day did I get to note down the names. It's now five:30 and I baraly know how often I've started with this little note since 9:30 a.m. I wanted also to send the cards: but then I thought probably you would not use them anyhow. So I am sending you blanks in case you wish them.
Many, many thanks and God's blessing to all
Fr. Solanus O.F.M.Cap.
